title: GTA 6 Launch Week: What To Know Before You Play #Shorts

scenes.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to launch on November nineteenth. Here is what to know before you play.

scenes.sub: PS5 AND XBOX SERIES X S
scenes.text: It is announced for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version for launch.
Big modern games take a lot of room, so check your console storage before launch day.
Watch out for fake download links and giveaways. Only trust Rockstar's official channels.
You are heading to Leonida, home of Vice City.
Rockstar's trailers have introduced two leads, Lucia and Jason.
Expect spoilers everywhere during launch week, so mute keywords on social media if you want to stay clean.
Follow for more Grand Theft Auto 6 news.

description:
What to know in GTA 6 launch week: the release date, announced platforms, a storage tip and a scam warning.

Information based on Rockstar's public announcements as of November 17, 2026. Release details can change, so check Rockstar's official channels for updates.

All visuals in this video are original graphics. No game footage is used.
